notes.title: Grammarian Hotfix Changelog Game Version A47
notes.notes:
Hello, Grammmarians!
Thank you for supporting and playing Grammarian. This update addresses minor changes and issues that have appeared in Grammarian Ltd.
General
Fixed a text in the "Computer Brain Virus" email that was incorrectly categorized as an intensive pronoun.

Corrected the classification of “mailman” as a compound word.

Fixed incorrect text in several documents.

Updated documents.
